info.title: MACsec_Secure_Association
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

create_time.description: Time (in seconds) since system boot when the SA was created.

enabled.description: Indicates if the Secure Association (SA) is enabled.

hw_status.description: The status of the SA in hardware.

error_code.description: Applicable only when the 'state' is set to 'error'.

state.description: The state of the SA in hardware.  `ok`:          The hardware was successful in creating the                 SA.  `in_progress`: The hardware is currently processing the                 SA.  `error`:       The hardware has encountered an error in                 creating the SA.

key_identifier.description: 128 bit identifier associated with the SAK generated using the Key Server's MI and a 32 bit Key Number (KN).

pn.description: Packet Number (PN) is a monotonically increasing number used to uniquely identify a MACsec frame in the sequence of frames transmitted or received using an SA. This gets updated every 2 seconds.

sak.description: Secret key to be used by SA to encrypt data plane packets for a MACsec connection. This is a transient key and is periodically refreshed.

secure_association_number.description:
Reference Resource: [MACsec_Secure_Association](#/MACsec_Secure_Association)
Set of MACsec Secure Associations uniquely identified by association number.

decrypted_bytes_rx.description: Number of plaintext octets recovered from encrypted packets that were integrity protected.

delayed_packets_rx.description: Number of packets received with a packet number (PN) lower than the lowest acceptable PN.

encrypted_bytes_tx.description: Number of plain text octets transmitted encrypted with integrity protection.

encrypted_packets_tx.description: Number of packets transmitted encrypted with integrity protection.

invalid_packets_rx.description: Number of packets received that failed validation when validate frames is set in 'check' mode.

late_packets_rx.description: Number of packets received with a PN lower than the lowest acceptable PN that were discarded.

not_in_use_sa_packets_tx.description: Number of packets transmitted while the SA was not in use.

not_using_sa_packets_rx.description: Number of received packets discarded that failed validation when validate frames is set in 'strict' mode or when the packet was encrypted on an unused SA.

not_valid_packets_rx.description: Number of received packets discarded that failed validation when validate frames is set in 'strict' mode or when the packet was encrypted.

ok_packets_rx.description: Number of packets received that were validated successfully.

protected_bytes_tx.description: Number of plain text octets transmitted with integrity protection.

protected_packets_tx.description: Number of packets transmitted in plain text with integrity protection.

too_long_packets_tx.description: Number of transmitted packets with length greater than the MTU of the interface that were discarded.

unchecked_packets_rx.description: Number of packets received that were not validated.

unused_sa_packets_rx.description: Number of packets received that failed validation when validate frames is not set to 'strict' mode on an unused SA.

validated_bytes_rx.description: Number of plaintext octets recovered from unencrypted packets that were integrity protected.

start_time.description: Time (in seconds) since system boot when the SA last transitioned to in-use.

stop_time.description: Time (in seconds) since system boot when the SA last transitioned out of in-use.

parameters.name: MACsec_Secure_Channel.sci
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [MACsec_Secure_Channel](#/MACsec_Secure_Channel)
Unique identifier for a given secure channel. It comprises the MAC address and a unique port number corresponding to the interface that this secure channel is instantiated for.

parameters.name: MACsec_Secure_Channel.channel_type
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [MACsec_Secure_Channel](#/MACsec_Secure_Channel)
The type of Secure Channel (SC). `receive`: This SC will be used to process traffic received from the peer(s). `transmit`: This SC will be used when transmitting traffic to the peer(s).

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
